card.name: End of the word Contraindications
card.fires_on: The final piece "ations" completing the word Contraindications (or contraindications), mostly in cross-references like "[see Contraindications (4)]" and in section headings.

modes.label: Cross-reference
modes.description: Completes Contraindications inside a bracketed "see Contraindications (4)" pointer after a contraindicated statement.
modes.example: are contraindicated in the setting of CABG [see Contraindic<<ations>> ( 4 )]. Post-MI

modes.label: Section heading or text
modes.description: Completes the word in a CONTRAINDICATIONS heading or in running text about contraindications.
modes.example: CONTRAINDICATIONS There are no absolute contraindic<<ations>> to the use of ragweed pollen extract

card.plain: It fires when the word Contraindications is being finished, usually in a "see Contraindications" pointer.
